cohort: Nulliparous women with singleton, term (37-42 weeks) deliveries between 2005 and 2024 were included.
finding: Macrosomia is independently associated with a higher risk of multiple adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in nulliparous women delivering at term.
mod_finding: The rate of intrapartum cesarean delivery was significantly higher among macrosomic deliveries, though this association was not statistically significant after adjustment.
birth_weight: macrosomic neonates (>=4000 g), control neonates (3000-3500 g), with stratification for neonates (>4500 g)
